notes.title: Ready to Hustle? This Update Means Business!
notes.content:
New Missions ✨
Swing by Austin's safehouse to complete new missions. Stay tuned for new characters with many more new missions in future updates. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/dcc26d7a40748ca6d1fecf33b6d2d6271fa84119.png"]
Business Ownership 💼
Max out your career stats in any job and become a business partner. Open the Careers app to buy in, earn passive income, and make key decisions to keep things running smoothly.


Once you've reached the highest rank in a job, you can also work anytime without selecting a shift, which will also boost the store's rating. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/904d69f5f4769b0eb71369c0f209afc4ce1920aa.png"]
Jail 👮
Watch out! Don't expand your narcotic production too much in the wrong place, or you could wind up doing hard time! 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e8f42ebfbd6e450966e890da0b57f212f723a59d.png"]
New Properties 🏚️
Three new properties have been added to the market. These properties allow you to work discreetly with narcotic equipment to avoid unwanted attention.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/9fbd33c1e06d909b950a646506d9d85086e079b8.png"]
Third-Person Camera 🎥
Try Denizen in a new perspective, with the newly added third-person camera. Use the "C" key to change camera on the go, and also manage it from the Settings menu. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0630bdba959981aab777f8ad3e7297b3ee59b1ca.png"]
New Lockpicking Minigame 🔒
Try a new challenge with the redesigned lockpicking minigame! Difficulty is now variable based on lock type, and the updated interface delivers a more intuitive experience. 


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/1105d1ff53ad9dbc0e93fe5721a610c733565570.png"]
Full Controller Support 🎮
Denizen is now available with full controller support, with on-the-fly input switching for easy playing.


Help Section ℹ️
A help section has been added to the main and pause menus, which includes info on various gameplay features.


Changelist 📃
• Added new missions

• Added business management feature

• Added intermittent business management events

• Added three new properties

• Added prison, arrest and medical events

• Added third-person camera option

• Added full controller support

• Added new lockpicking minigame

• Added help section to main/pause menu

• Added footstep audio toggle

• Added task delete function to Agenda app

What's Next?
More content is on the way! Look forward to new missions, new features, and many more tweaks, fixes, and improvements.



Thank you for playing Denizen and for providing your valuable feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Update 0.24.0 - New Opportunities Await!
notes.content:
Narcotic Production
Capitalize on the opportunity to acquire specialized equipment and ingredients to launch and grow a narcotic production operation in the competitive market!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/44596560968430b9a10de9da75ae9ef6543b0b5a.png

Use the new Black Market website on your smartphone to conveniently order equipment and ingredients, with discreet courier delivery right to your doorstep.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/8fa533064220093092b154d8fb73cf8734770a58.png

Retail
You can now stock your retail shops by ordering inventory directly from the new MegaMerch website. Simply add your desired merchandise to the cart, choose your preferred shipping method, and your products will be on their way to your store in no time!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d86708b102ea5badcbb996676b553a705388cef1.png

For those who prefer a more hands-on approach, a new cargo vehicle has just been added to the used car dealership!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0ff03ec120f858c61c32beefcbb9e2e7286a5375.png

The inventory loading interface has also been improved with a condensed transfer list, so you can now select the number of units or transfer all inventory matching the store type. Logic has also been added to prevent loading merchandise that doesn't match the store type.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e6efb484b1bead8d58a5ce6a54b8049f14f16493.png

Courier
A new courier location in town provides a secure service for shipping your products, ensuring complete confidentiality for you and your clients!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/51057ab70aa243dfdb40e6a997a2e104ff9b3bf3.png

Other changes
Be sure to check out the new Statistics app on the smartphone, where you can track your in-game progress! There have also been some new achievements added, and several more additions and changes listed in the changelog below:

Experience the thrill of speed at the newly opened Cedar Shores Drag Strip! Test your skills and push your limits on the new track. After gearing up your vehicle, place a wager with a rival of your choice and get ready to enjoy the action and maybe make some money!

notes.title: Early Access preview
notes.content:
Denizen is almost here. Let's take a closer look at some of the features that will be included in the initial Early Access release!

Properties
Denizen features a variety of homes to choose from that can each be customized to your liking. Each home is designed with a unique layout and characteristics.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d31c96c7d446bca548706c34a0402681c35ce0b5.jpg

Retail
The retail business feature was a popular addition to the pre-release build and has been further developed for the Early Access build.

You will have the option to rent out additional stores with varying inventory capacities and customer traffic. New product types have also been added to the warehouse.

Also, a new cargo truck is available that's great for hauling all that merchandise!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/43d61f5c0c616721487d74f1e1be585aa35d3b4c.jpg

Social
A key feature of Denizen is the Social feature which will be built upon in future updates of the game.

Use your smartphone to meet new friends by chatting through the Social app. After making friends, you can invite them over to your home to hang out!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/6b8fc0debbf5011724a09d019e1f62bba060d5a9.png

Shores Casino
Head out to the east side of the city for some entertainment at the Shores Casino. Choose from a variety of games to play including slots and table games. In a future update during Early Access, you'll also be able to spend the night at the hotel which features a selection of premium rooms to stay in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/b4055bc23821e12d3f62c7412292bb8692cd5d4c.jpg

Car Dealerships
Vehicles are an integral part of Denizen, and you can pick the perfect vehicle to make your way around the city by visiting one of several dealerships that offer a range of automobiles to choose from.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e1f2f3285eb487a7c6abb2fe75b51c263d094492.jpg

Other content
• Expanded map
• New jobs
• New missions
• Furniture store
• Clothing store
• Nightclub
• City NPC interaction
• Revised traffic system
• And much more!

Thank you
The community has been hugely supportive and helpful during the demo run. Thank you for your feedback and support!

There is much more to come for Denizen, and community feedback will be essential for shaping its future.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2010030/Denizen/

notes.title: Demo update 0.17.0
notes.content:
0.17.0
The 1.17.0 demo update is now live with additional content and improvements. Check out the latest new features!

Vehicles and car wash
Improvements have been made to vehicle physics, audio, and NPC traffic. There has also been another vehicle added to the used car dealership.

Vehicles now accumulate dirt while they are driven off-road, so of course a car wash had to be added!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/e1aaa5d90aa6aac0e2b35151b2d832100fca6c36.png

Smartphone apps
New apps have been added to the smartphone:

• Assets app: This app allows you to sell and rent out your owned properties. You can also view a list of your owned vehicles. More to come with this app in a future build.

• Utilities app: The Utilities app tracks the daily electric and water bills for your properties. The amounts for these bills are withdrawn from your account at the end of each day.

• Maps app: A map has been added to the phone for easier navigation around the city.

Also, the original three property apps have been condensed into one.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7048cc2fa5863a0e00385d5123670e0dae6b9928.png

Residence customization
When purchasing paint for your home, you now have the option to customize the color as well as select the type of finish you want.

New furniture and electronics have been added. Play custom videos on the TV, or try playing your own music with the music player. Make sure to check out the new customizable light fixtures!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/ee84179a088c483cd105a18d904b8d9c980fb224.png

New house
Another house has been added to the market. This residence includes a garage for vehicle storage!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/f53b85ebfc00e2e75daa5f3b8d576a057684d85b.png

Visuals
Environment art has received an overhaul that focuses on foliage and lighting improvements.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/89fe8a0c7136445e0e0c18e22ddfb4037da10e31.png

Other content
Loads of other fixes and revisions have also been included in this update. If you do encounter any issues, please feel welcome to report them in the community forums!

Release date
A release date of Q1 2024 is now public on the Denizen store page. Thank you for your ongoing support and feedback!

There are some exciting content previews on the way that offer a peek into what the Early Access version will offer.

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
0.11.0
The 0.11.0 demo update is now available! This update includes new content in addition to many refinements to gameplay and visuals listed below. As development of the Early Access version of Denizen continues, there will be further updates to the playable demo.

Retail
The new retail feature has been added which allows you to rent a property and open your own business. Stock up on wholesale consumer goods from the local warehouse and manage your store to maximize profits. To access this new feature, simply press the "R" key to open the new retail management interface.

In the Early Access version of Denizen, there will be additional stores to rent, each with a unique design, product inventory capacities, and customer traffic. This means you can create your own stores to fit your choice of brand and shopping experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/f313384602b37bf23a10da6ee4c741f9bddaa579.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/0b6973f45ee945c357454c537a9a65ecb3a313af.png

Visuals
Lighting and graphics have undergone a significant overhaul to enhance the overall visual experience, while the rural city environment has been given more character through a complete revamp. Continued progress has been made on the rest of the game map, including the downtown district that will be accessible in the Early Access release.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/46561e3623242e3543d3101b011eb55f62c196b5.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/7cb56403a2bc13d4330bdd5dd8e1e742a6fc1990.png

Bar
Stop by the new local bar to unwind after a long day of work. Have a drink and try your luck at the blackjack table!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d2bdd76ccf5d060dbd9e9c45b56789a8b5219618.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/d978c35bd93fed3493b0f64f6ca8bbda842cee27.png

Other content
The new clinic location offers a selection of medications and medical operations to help you manage your needs. Fuel consumption has been added to vehicles, in addition to a speedometer and fuel gauge. You can now refuel your car at the gas station.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/38178bccb9aa3d5c7180e8ad2eaa5a6e23e85ddd.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/33fd3450ffd6432defb739a66cff4f175e72e234.png

There have also been many bug fixes and tweaks made in this update. A character creation feature was introduced in a recent unannounced update as well!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43160695/c85a76fb64d802e2904b8929e3ca704f56881857.png

More to come!
Thank you for playing Denizen, and please visit the discussion forums to leave any feedback or suggestions you may have!
